article_title: Zoos help to save snail found in only one lake in Wales

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A plan to remove all snails from Welsh lakes
A conservation project creating zoo populations to save the rare glutinous snail
A new Egyptian artefact discovered in Eryri
A study showing that algae have disappeared from Britain
tasks.correct_answer: A conservation project creating zoo populations to save the rare glutinous snail
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת במאמץ של משפחת יוז, גני חיות וארגוני שימור ליצור אוכלוסיות גיבוי ולהציל את החילזון הדביק.

tasks.prompt: Where is the glutinous snail's last known wild refuge in the UK?
options: The River Thames
A pond at Dudley Zoo
Llyn Tegid in Eryri National Park
A greenhouse in Kent
tasks.correct_answer: Llyn Tegid in Eryri National Park
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המפלט הטבעי האחרון הידוע של המין בבריטניה הוא אגם לין טגיד שבפארק הלאומי ארירי בוויילס.

tasks.prompt: What is an “ark population” in this conservation project?
options: A collection of ancient objects kept in a museum
A group of animals transported only by boat
A backup captive population kept safe away from the single wild site
A population that is too large for its habitat
tasks.correct_answer: A backup captive population kept safe away from the single wild site
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ark population היא אוכלוסיית גיבוי בשבי, שנועדה להפחית את הסיכון שכל המין תלוי באתר טבעי יחיד.

tasks.prompt: What breakthrough occurred four months after Hughes set up his captive population?
options: The snails grew larger than a hand
The lake was declared pollution-free
A new species of beetle was discovered
Eggs appeared in the tank
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לאחר ארבעה חודשים נמצאו ביצים במכל — פריצת דרך, משום שלדברי יוז איש לא ראה קודם ביצים של המין באופן מודע.

tasks.prompt: Why does Hughes say that having “all your eggs in one basket” is dangerous?
options: A disease or environmental event at one site could threaten the entire population
Snail eggs cannot survive in zoo ponds
The family wants to stop breeding snails
The species can live only in Egyptian museums
tasks.correct_answer: A disease or environmental event at one site could threaten the entire population
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר כל החילזונות מרוכזים במקום אחד, אירוע מקומי עלול לפגוע בכולם; פיזורם בין גני חיות מפחית את הסיכון.

tasks.prompt: What does “fathom what it needs” mean in Hughes's description of early breeding work?
options: Measure the lake's depth exactly
Understand the snail's requirements
Count every snail in England
Move the species to deeper water
tasks.explanation_hebrew: fathom בהקשר זה פירושו להבין לעומק מה החילזון צריך כדי לשרוד ולהתרבות.

tasks.prompt: Describe the work Ian Hughes carried out before zoos joined the project.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את האיסוף ברישיון, המחקר באגם, בניית המחסות, גידול האוכלוסייה בשבי והצלחת הרבייה.
expected_points: He has collected and studied the snails under licence since 2014
He waded into Llyn Tegid to find them
He designed and installed concrete shelters in the lake
He created a captive population in a greenhouse at home
He used homemade tanks in his garden
Eggs appeared after four months
The captive population grew to about 2,000 snails

tasks.prompt: Explain why zoos are useful partners in preparing for a future reintroduction.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין פיזור הסיכון, מתקני הרבייה, המומחיות והמחקר הנדרש לפני השבה לטבע.
expected_points: Zoos create separate backup populations
They reduce dependence on the single population at Llyn Tegid
They provide controlled ponds and specialist care
They can breed the snails and study environmental needs
Partners are researching ecology, husbandry and genetics
Research can help identify suitable release sites
A stronger evidence base makes reintroduction safer

expected_points: The snail was once widespread but is now extinct across England
Its last known UK wild site is Llyn Tegid

Ian Hughes established a successful captive population
